0022600156.text: The Golden State Warriors (3-3, 1-1 at home) enter this seventh game of the 2026-27 season on a three-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and 10th in the West, while the LA Clippers (1-4) have lost four straight and are 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back and 14th in the West. Golden State's Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery) are out, and LA's Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery) are also out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the 2025-26 season series in which the Warriors lost 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 115-110 Warriors loss in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
